title: Reading Drill — Assessing paper for printed maps — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Assessing paper for printed maps — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The map publisher in Hillswick received an old report about maps tearing at folds after light rain. The report compared the number of folds before tearing, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the controlled tests rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include different printing inks. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed water-resistant paper as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
